answer: Sybil resistance can come from bonded identity: each agent locks a stake recorded on a shared ledger before it may act or vote. Faking a thousand agents means funding a thousand bonds, spreading a lone attacker's capital thin as sand across a dune. Honest peers echo attestations of genuine work, and any identity caught cheating is slashed, dropping off its narrow ledge of staked collateral. Cost rises linearly with each identity; earned trust does not.
